payload.reason: The evidence indicates that ARAML significantly improves the stability and performance of text generation compared to traditional GANs and other baselines.

claims.text: ARAML outperforms state-of-the-art text GANs with a more stable training process.
The generator in ARAML avoids high variance in reward signals, leading to more stable performance.
Experiments show ARAML achieves better performance on three text generation tasks with lower training variance.
